description.summary: The Kirin (Japanese: 麒麟, also Qilin in Chinese, Gilen in Korean) is one of East Asia's most revered mythological creatures - a chimeric beast that combines features of dragons, deer, oxen, and other animals to create a benevolent divine being symbolizing prosperity, serenity, and the arrival of wise rulers.
description.full: The Kirin (Japanese: 麒麟, also Qilin in Chinese, Gilen in Korean) is one of East Asia's most revered mythological creatures - a chimeric beast that combines features of dragons, deer, oxen, and other animals to create a benevolent divine being symbolizing prosperity, serenity, and the arrival of wise rulers. Unlike Western unicorns, the kirin is not a simple horned horse but a complex composite creature whose very appearance signals heaven's approval. Appearing only during times of peace or at the birth/death of great sages, the kirin represents the pinnacle of virtue in the animal kingdom - a creature so gentle it will not harm even grass beneath its hooves, yet so powerful it can ward off evil and validate divine authority.
